note: Negatives are near-misses against network-path-debug, seams-and-modularity, fix-once, gate-triage, perf-pass and perspective-gate. five-ways fires when direct attempts have already failed and the choice of APPROACH is the open question; those siblings each own a domain where the approach is already settled - test the layers in order, put a seam around the clock, write the check after the fix, classify a red suite, or profile before optimising. perspective-gate is the sharpest of them: it shares the whole 'come at it from a different angle' vocabulary but aims it at an artifact under review rather than a bug that has survived a fix, so each set carries the other as a negative.
